fault_reports.title: Computer Not Starting
fault_reports.description: The computer does not start when the power button is pressed. The screen remains blank.

fault_reports.title: Leaking Water Tap
fault_reports.description: The water tap is leaking continuously, causing water to collect on the floor.

fault_reports.title: Broken Classroom Light
fault_reports.description: The ceiling light is not working, leaving part of the classroom poorly illuminated.

fault_reports.title: Faulty Network Connection
fault_reports.description: The network cable connection is not working, preventing the computer from accessing the internet.

fault_reports.title: Broken Classroom Chair
fault_reports.description: One leg of the classroom chair is broken, making it unstable and unsafe to use.
